entries.7e57e17a8b368b81: A holding company that oversees a group of food supermarkets with Yaoko at its core, operating 276 stores in the Kanto and Tokai regions.
entries.7f419762f84e0dad: The mission is "to realize a world (Blue Zone) where all people in the region can enjoy every day in good health," and the vision is "to become a shared community asset (commons)." The 11th Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years ended March 2025 to March 2027) has the main theme "Becoming stronger together as a group." Under it, the lifestyle-format and discount-format companies aim to improve their share of trade areas by each achieving autonomous growth. The long-term numerical targets are "500 stores and net sales of ¥1 trillion."
entries.8380772f69753501: It generates net sales by selling merchandise in its stores. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥783,434 million. As this is the first fiscal period since the company's establishment, no comparison with the prior period is presented.
entries.85703368f047d95c: Yaoko, the core company, operates 202 stores in the Kanto region, centered on Saitama Prefecture, and as a food supermarket that attracts frequent visits from small trade areas, it responds closely to the different needs of each region. In addition, the group includes companies with different business models, such as AVV and Foocut, which offer overwhelmingly low prices and low-cost operations, which is a distinctive feature.

entries.9193c4aed87fa29c: Established on October 1, 2025, through a simple share transfer as the wholly owning parent company of Yaoko Co., Ltd., the company comprises 10 subsidiaries and 3 affiliates, centered on itself (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.9d7b8c5384a2df9c: Subsidiaries including Yaoko, AVV, Sendo, Foocut and Bunkado sell mainly food products through lifestyle-format and discount-format stores. The number of stores across the group as of March 31, 2026 was 276.
entries.9d86bcf4bd4af202: The group’s only business (a single segment), operating supermarkets centered on food products. Operating subsidiaries, led by Yaoko, operate stores, and as of March 31, 2026, the group had 276 stores. Store formats consist of two types: lifestyle formats that propose ways of eating, and discount formats that emphasize low prices.
entries.a8fe55a840fb0b47: The discount-format companies AVV and Foocut secure profit by thoroughly pursuing low-cost operations, including the use of process centers and efficient store operations. Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥23,596 million.
